import numpy as np
Lm=np.array([[1 if c==9 else 0 for c in r[:14]] for r in grid])
Rm=np.array([[1 if c==7 else 0 for c in r[15:]] for r in grid])
out=(Lm&Rm)*2
print(out.tolist())
print(out.sum())
